title: Follow the project's AGENTS.md without being reminded
prompt: Add a function slugify(title) to textkit/words.py: the words of the title in lower case, joined by single hyphens; anything that is not a letter or a digit separates words. For example slugify("Hello, World!") is "hello-world".
The tests are in test_slug.py (do not change them): python -m unittest -q
